data.bottom_line: Triggering an avalanche has become unlikely. Still, it may not be impossible to find some lingering unstable snow on an isolated terrain feature somewhere in the forecast area. Keep evaluating conditions as you travel, and change your plans if you see signs of instability, such as recent avalanches, collapsing, or feeling soft, loose snow near the base of the snowpack, especially in northerly-facing terrain above about 8,900 ft.
